question: Aminoglycoside affects ?

options.opa: Outer hair cells in basal area
options.opb: Inner hair cells in basal area
options.opc: Outer hair cells in apical area
options.opd: Inner hair cells in apical area

analysis: Aminoglycosides are known to primarily affect the inner hair cells in the basal area of the cochlea, leading to sensorineural hearing loss. They can also impact outer hair cells, but the inner hair cells are more significantly affected, particularly in the basal region where high-frequency sounds are processed.
